column1: Cohesion / ease of conflation with other network datasets / interoperability?
column5:
Attributes joined to other (typically road-centerline) network graphs via simple overlap and require post-processing to remove false positives/negatives.

Example: Bicycle facilities represented as simple lines that only generally follow where the bicycle facilities are. Line nodes are not strategically placed at intersections.
column8:
Network is completely referenced to a larger network graph? Requires minimal effort to conflate with referenced network graph but may require more effort to conflate with other sources.

Example: Spec data developed alongside OSM and features are referenced/connected with OSM features. Would be relatively straightforward to join back to OSM but might be dififcult to join to a new municipal/licensed network dataset.
